build_optimizer: build a PyTorch optimizer from timm or torch.optim with configurable parameters
build_lr_scheduler: build a learning rate scheduler from timm or torch.optim.lr_scheduler with configurable parameters
parse_params: parse a comma-separated parameter string into a dictionary with name and float values
create_scaling_scheduler: create a ScalingScheduler that adjusts a model attribute across epochs using linear or cosine schedules
freeze_grads: freeze model gradients temporarily using a context manager and restore them afterward
